classification: POST-HOC MATCHED EVALUATION ON THE HISTORICAL 128-SEED 6V6 BLOCK. Not confirmatory. Not fresh seeds. Not PAPER-FAITHFUL. Does not replace any future untouched evaluation of the dual-branch method.
decided_by: PI, 2026-10-02: same three-view pattern as 2v2 — old top-50 (provenance), dual-branch own top-50 (best-case capability), matched 128 (fair overall comparison).
THE_QUESTION: On the identical 128 historical 6v6 seeds, how do the dual-branch role composite's crossover deltas (win rate and score margin) compare with the old asymmetric Ours sealed on that block?

SYSTEM_locked.allocator: CLOSEST_DEFENDS(k=2), roles fixed for the episode
SYSTEM_locked.unchanged_from_top50_diagnostic: same dual-branch deploy pins and CLOSEST_DEFENDS(k) as any provenance historical-top50 run; seeds are the full SPENT block (not a seed-list subset)

POSTHOC_MATCHED128_6V6_DUAL_BRANCH.note: PRIMARY Stage-3 evidence: all four cells on all 128 seeds of the SPENT block; no seed spent, block status unchanged. Historical top-50 is provenance only.

READING.hierarchy: Matched-128 = primary evidence; own top-50 derived from these rows = secondary descriptive; historical top-50 = provenance/regression only (not required for claims).
READING.per_system: V(A,A), V(B,A), V(A,B), V(B,B); Delta_A = V(A,A) - V(B,A); Delta_B = V(B,B) - V(A,B); the same deltas on score margin (blue - red)
READING.comparison: paired within seed against the old asymmetric Ours rows sealed on this block (standardized_6v6_split_k1_confirmatory_specialist_crossover_eval_rows.csv)
READING.statistics: mean +- std (ddof=1) per delta; 95% paired percentile bootstrap (n=20000, alpha=0.05, rng 7) via eval_hog_psp_v3._mean_ci
READING.own_top50: after this seal, experiments/select_own_top50.py --scale 6 applies the historical selection rule to these rows (best-case capability; not an unbiased estimate)

LAUNCH.when: inside 6v6/run_dual_branch_6v6.py after the technical seal (default Stage-3 path)
